title: The scent of this one in particular is missing something
text: The scent of this one in particular is missing something. I have bought this before and I love it it is fantastic but this one in particular does not smell as good as I expected, all the other scented ones smell amazing this one is lacking an extra kick in my opinion scent wise, otherwise very good quality incense and the other scents of this same one are incredible I love them!

product_metadata.title: Nippon Kodo Kayuragi Incense Sticks - Cherry Blossom, Japanese Quality Incense
features: Contains 40 sticks and an incense holder
No bamboo core for a clean burning, pure scent
description: The fragrance of cherry blossom, full of the tenderness of spring in all its glory.  Welcome to the world of Kayuragi, where fragrance "Ka" meets with slowly wafting scented smoke "Yuragi". Comfortable fragrance, where calm wafts in. Inspired by Kimono (Japanese traditional wear) fabric, the package texture is smooth, and the coloring is dramatic. The Kayuragi series includes the popular Aloeswood and Sandalwood fragrances as well as 9 Japanese floral and fruity fragrances.  When the incense is lit, it's smoke and aroma wafts throughout the space and brings a feeling of relief and relaxation. It is not only from the pleasant fragrance, but also from the sight of the wafting smoke which will make you feel at ease. Beautiful Kayuragi incense box contains 40 sticks of incense and a mini ceramic holder. Each incense burns about 25 minutes. - No bamboo core, clean burning, pure scent - Box includes 40 sticks and a mini ceramic holder - Beautiful package, perfect for a small gift - For meditation, relaxation, stress reduction, massaging, reading, yoga, bathing - Less smoke when burning.
